zh-CN.title: 合并聊天记录可直接预览
items: 聊天中的一级合并记录改为可滚动的内嵌聊天预览
进入完整预览后，可继续直接查看其中包含的合并记录
更深层的合并内容仍以卡片收纳，保持消息流清晰易用

en.title: Preview merged chat records inline
items: Top-level merged records now appear as scrollable chat previews inside conversations
Opening the full preview also reveals merged records contained within it
Deeper nested records stay compact as cards to keep the message flow easy to follow
